map.每项有固定权重，勾选「正常/轻微/异常」对应不同得分系数（异常计 0 且列入问题: Each item has a fixed weight, and ticking normal / minor / abnormal maps to different score coefficients (abnormal scores 0 and enters the issue list); group scores are aggregated by weight into a total and mapped to a condition grade. Weights follow item importance, with structural parts (frame, suspension) weighted above trim.
map.购车前对目标车做底盘系统逐项检查，覆盖大梁锈蚀、悬挂异响、排气渗漏等 12 项关: Before buying a car, inspect the chassis system of the target vehicle item by item, covering 12 key areas such as frame rust, suspension noise and exhaust leaks.
map.：12 个检查项各按权重计分（正常=满分、轻微=部分分、异常=0 分并计入问题清: : the 12 inspection items are scored by weight (normal = full marks, minor = partial, abnormal = 0 and added to the issue list). If the frame, suspension or exhaust shows "abnormal", the corresponding group loses significant weight and the total maps to a poor condition grade with key risks flagged; if only a few non-load-bearing parts have minor rust, the total still sits at moderate. The report aggregates scores and issues by group for targeted negotiation.
